trajectory-indirect-prompt-injection-72 · benchmark task: The Trajectory 72 evaluation used the same Trajectory Labs browser integration for Claude Code and Codex, exposing MCP tools as wrappers around Chrome APIs; first-party browser-extension safeguards were outside the test.
